note: Licenses can change. Re-check the exact repository/file before production.

resources.name: KodeLife
resources.use: Native real-time shader prototyping in GLSL, HLSL, Metal and compute stages.
resources.cost: Try-before-buy desktop download; one-time license for continued licensed use.
resources.commercial: Use the tool under its EULA; shader code remains subject to its own provenance.
resources.risk: LOW for original shaders; not open source.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Prototype shaders and export code; do not make the website depend on KodeLife.

resources.name: The Book of Shaders
resources.use: Free structured learning for fragment shaders, noise, shapes, matrices and generative patterns.
resources.license: Repository-specific license; read before copying substantial code.
resources.commercial: Use concepts freely; verify license for copied text/code.
resources.risk: MEDIUM if copying; LOW if learning.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Learning and mechanism research.

resources.name: glslCanvas
resources.use: Load GLSL fragment/vertex shaders into an HTML canvas.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Fast prototypes and documentation embeds.

resources.name: Hydra
resources.use: Browser live-coding video synth with framebuffer mixing and chained transforms.
resources.commercial: Possible, but embedding/modifying the engine can carry AGPL source obligations.
resources.risk: MEDIUM/HIGH for product embedding; LOW for standalone experimentation.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Explore motion recipes; avoid bundling without deliberate AGPL review.

resources.name: textmode.js
resources.use: Real-time ASCII/textmode graphics using WebGL2, layers, custom shaders and exports.
resources.license: MIT; bundled default font reported as CC0.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Best external option for advanced ASCII scenes.

resources.name: Three.js AsciiEffect
resources.use: Convert Three.js rendering into ASCII output.
resources.license: Three.js project license applies; verify current repository notice.
resources.commercial: Generally suitable under project license; preserve notices.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Useful when KODEX uses actual Three.js geometry.

resources.name: Moebius
resources.use: Desktop ANSI/ASCII editor with half-block painting and collaboration.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Author static ANSI panels, sigils and terminal illustrations.

resources.name: FIGlet
resources.use: Generate large text banners from ordinary text.
resources.license: BSD-style project license; individual FIGlet fonts may have their own terms.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Generate terminal titles; the included KODEX generator avoids external fonts.

resources.name: Keijiro ShaderSketches
resources.use: KodeLife-oriented GLSL sketches covering procedural forms and animation.
resources.commercial: Code can be reused; attribute GIFs if used.
resources.risk: LOW for code; attribution required for GIFs.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Study concise mechanisms; rebuild with KODEX composition.

resources.name: WebGL Fluid Simulation
resources.use: Interactive GPU fluid simulation that works in mobile browsers.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Advanced liquid mode after the lighter procedural acid shader in this pack.

resources.name: TWGL.js
resources.use: Small helper layer that reduces raw WebGL boilerplate.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Alternative to the zero-dependency runtime included here.

resources.name: regl
resources.use: Functional abstraction for WebGL resources and draw commands.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Good for data-driven GPU modules; less ideal if WebGL2-only features dominate.

resources.name: p5.js
resources.use: Accessible browser creative-coding environment.
resources.license: Open source; verify current repository license and dependency obligations.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Sketching and workshops; not required for final KODEX runtime.

resources.name: Tone.js
resources.use: Web Audio framework for synthesis, timing, effects and interactive music.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Use only if KODEX needs transport/synthesis; raw Web Audio is enough for FFT input.

resources.name: CRT-Lottes
resources.use: Well-known CRT scanline/shadow-mask shader.
resources.license: Original shader is described as public domain by multiple ports.
resources.commercial: Generally usable, but preserve provenance in notices.
resources.risk: LOW after verifying the exact source file.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Reference for advanced CRT; this pack contains an original lightweight CRT shader.

resources.name: windows-terminal-shaders
resources.use: CRT, monochrome, glow and terminal postprocessing examples.
resources.license: Repository displays CC0-1.0; README documents unresolved provenance around some Retro.hlsl-derived changes.
resources.commercial: Use only files with clear provenance; avoid ambiguous branches/snippets.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Study controls and terminology, not blind copy/paste.

resources.name: Shadertoy
resources.use: Large shader community and browser editor.
resources.license: Per-shader license; unmarked shaders are not automatically commercially safe.
resources.commercial: Require an explicitly compatible license or author permission.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Inspiration and learning only unless license is explicit.

resources.name: CodePen
resources.use: Browser prototyping and sharing.
resources.license: Public Pens are MIT licensed; private Pens have no implicit license.
resources.commercial: Public Pen code can be reused under MIT notice requirements.
resources.risk: LOW for public code with preserved notice.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Search for small UI/Canvas mechanisms, not complete identity systems.

resources.name: ambientCG
resources.use: PBR textures, HDRIs and models.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Paper, dust, concrete and surface masks—optimize before web use.

resources.name: Poly Haven
resources.use: High-quality textures, HDRIs and models.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Use selectively for 3D artifacts and environmental lighting.

resources.name: Openverse
resources.use: Search openly licensed images and audio.
resources.license: Search engine; each result retains its own license.
resources.commercial: Filter and verify every asset license and attribution requirement.
resources.recommended_for_kodex: Find archival/scientific source material with traceable provenance.
